key.name: tray-icon
key.summary: Show an icon in the system tray
key.description: Exports a StatusNotifierItem. Needs a host to pick it up: on GNOME that means the AppIndicator extension. With no host the icon simply never appears, which is why this defaults to on rather than being detected.

key.name: run-in-background
key.summary: Keep running when the window is closed
key.description: Closing the window hides it instead of quitting, so the tray icon stays live. Ignored when tray-icon is off, since a background process with no icon would be unreachable.
